concepts.text:
Label: City administration contact and opening hours
Description: Address, telephone number and regular public opening hours of Stadtverwaltung Wallisellen.
Aliases: Stadtverwaltung; Stadthaus; administration hours; Oeffnungszeiten; contact Wallisellen; opening hours; holiday closures; closed
Questions: Where is the Wallisellen city administration and when is it open?
Published facts:
Stadtverwaltung Wallisellen is at Zentralstrasse 9, 8304 Wallisellen, telephone 044 832 61 11. Its regular hours are Monday to Wednesday 08:30-11:30 and 13:30-16:30, Thursday 08:30-11:30 and 13:30-18:30, and Friday 07:00-14:00; the official page separately lists exceptional closures.
The administration page lists holiday closures for 2026/2027: closed all day on 24 and 31 December 2026, 1 January 2027, 26 and 29 March 2027 (Good Friday, Easter Monday), 6 May 2027 (Ascension) and 17 May 2027 (Whit Monday); closed from 11:30 on 14 September 2026 (Knabenschiessen) and 19 April 2027 (Sechseläuten); and closed from 15:00 on 25 March 2027 and 5 May 2027.

Label: Digital city services
Description: The official online counter, eUmzug route, city map and emergency-number entry point.
Aliases: Online-Schalter; eUmzug; Stadtkarte; Notfallnummern; online services
Questions: Which Wallisellen services can I reach online?
Published facts:
The city describes its Online-Schalter as a way to use many municipal services directly from home.
The official homepage routes moving-in, moving-away and within-Wallisellen address notifications to the eUmzugCH portal.
The official homepage links an emergency-numbers page for important telephone numbers in emergencies.
The online counter lists services that can be completed online, among them a residence confirmation (Wohnsitzbestätigung), ordering a residence or home-town certificate, a tax-return deadline extension and a certificate of capacity to act, and links external services for debt enforcement and criminal record extracts and for eUmzug registration, deregistration and moves.

Label: Population services
Description: What the municipal population-services entry point covers.
Aliases: Bevoelkerungsdienste; Einwohnerkontrolle; identity card; residence certificate; dog registration; Datensperre; dog tax; dog levy; Hundeabgabe; passport; ID card; Personenmeldeamt; registration office; residents' registration office; Einwohnerdienste
Questions: What can Wallisellen population services help with?
Published facts:
Wallisellen's population-services page provides entry points for eUmzugZH; identity cards and passports; residence certificates, residence documents and address information; dog registration; and blocking access to personal data.
Dogs older than three months must be registered with the Bevölkerungsdienste Wallisellen within ten days, in addition to the AMICUS database; first-time dog keepers report to the Bevölkerungsdienste beforehand.
The annual dog levy is 180.00 francs per dog (municipality 150.00 francs, canton 30.00 francs), halved when dog keeping starts after 30 June or the dog reaches three months only then.

Label: Moving registration in Wallisellen
Description: Deadline, online route and cases requiring an in-person visit when moving.
Aliases: Umzug melden; Zuzug; Wegzug; eUmzugCH; moving to Wallisellen; moving abroad; deregister; deregistration; moving away; leaving Switzerland; address change; change of address; weekly resident; Abmeldung; moved; moved to Wallisellen; register my move
Questions: How and when do I report a move in Wallisellen?; Must I appear in person when moving from abroad?
Published facts:
A move must be reported within 14 days; an adult can also report family members in the same household, including children up to age 17.
Moving in, moving away or changing address within Wallisellen can be reported through the eUmzugCH portal.
Weekly residents must register in person at the population-services counter.
A person moving to Wallisellen from abroad must register in person at the population-services counter.
A person moving abroad must deregister in person at the residents' registration office.
When moving with children following separation or divorce, Wallisellen requires the other parent's consent.

Label: Civil status, deaths and naturalisation entry points
Description: Where the municipal site routes civil-status, death and naturalisation questions.
Aliases: Zivilstand; Todesfall; Bestattungsamt; Einbuergerung; naturalisation
Questions: Where should a death be reported in Wallisellen?; Does Wallisellen distinguish naturalisation routes?
Published facts:
The city directs people to contact the Bestattungsamt when a death occurs.
The municipal naturalisation page provides separate entry points for foreign nationals and Swiss nationals.

Label: Waste disposal services and reminders
Description: Reuse options, calendar import, collection reminders and the responsible municipal contact.
Aliases: Entsorgung; Entsorgungskalender; Sammeltermine; Bring- und Holboerse; ReparierBar; repair; repair cafe; second-hand items; waste collection; rubbish collection; garbage pickup; collection dates; email reminder; Abfallsammlung; Gebiet Blau; Gebiet Gelb; blue zone; yellow zone; blue area; yellow area; collection area; collection zone; waste calendar; Entsorgungsdaten
Questions: Can I subscribe to Wallisellen waste collection reminders?; Which waste collection zones does Wallisellen have?
Published facts:
Wallisellen lists the Bring- und Holboerse and ReparierBar as options for reusing items.
Waste collection dates can be imported into an electronic calendar; users with an account can receive email reminders for collection dates in their area. The page gives Umwelt at 044 832 62 10 and umwelt@wallisellen.ch as the contact.
The waste-collections page lists collection dates by area, Gebiet Blau and Gebiet Gelb, can be narrowed to one area, and offers to import all dates into the user's calendar.
The collection-points page lists Stadthaus Parkplatz, Säntis-/Bubentalstrasse, Altes Gemeindehaus, Melchrüti, Mülliland Entsorgungscenter, the Sonderabfallmobil, Zwicky and Richti.
The Entsorgungskalender 2026 (PDF) marks the city's collection points on a map, refers to www.wallisellen.ch/abfallsammlung for importing collection dates and gives the disposal telephone 044 832 62 10.
According to the Entsorgungskalender 2026, the ReparierBar in the old fire station, Zentralstrasse 4, opens on Saturdays from 9.00 to 12.00 on the calendar dates; volunteers repair household, electronic, metal, wood, textile and toy items free of charge, material is charged. The Bring- und Holboerse, Rosenbergstrasse 2, is open every Thursday 16.00-18.00 and Saturday 10.00-12.00, closed in school holidays and on public holidays, for bringing and taking clean, working items free of charge. The main collection point Muelliland (REMONDIS Recycling AG, Kriesbachstrasse 2, 044 878 10 40) takes waste of all kinds during its opening hours, some fractions against a fee; the small-animal carcass collection point is REMONDIS Recycling AG, Kriesbachstrasse 1.

Label: Waste categories collected
Description: The categories present in the city's waste-type directory.
Aliases: Abfallarten; recycling; household waste; special waste; green waste
Questions: Which waste categories does Wallisellen list?
Published facts:
The official waste-type directory covers household waste and bulky waste, paper and cardboard, glass and metals, batteries and electrical equipment, green waste, special waste, textiles and shoes, animal carcasses and other separately collected categories.

Label: Waste collection days and dates by area (Gebiet Blau and Gebiet Gelb)
Description: Weekly collection days and the listed 2026 dates for household waste, green waste, cardboard and paper in the blue and yellow collection areas, and the dates of the special collections.
Aliases: Abfuhrtag; Abfuhrdaten; Kehrichtabfuhr; Kehricht; Karton; Papier; Altpapier; Abholung; abgeholt; Abfallkalender; collection day; collection dates; pickup day; next pickup; bin day; rubbish day; garbage day; household waste collection; green waste collection; paper collection; cardboard collection; metal collection; blue zone; yellow zone; blue area; yellow area; Gebiet Blau; Gebiet Gelb; Haushaltkehricht; Grüngut; Haushaltkarton; Papiersammlung; Metallsammlung; Häckseldienst; Sonderabfallmobil
Questions: When is household waste collected in Gebiet Blau and Gebiet Gelb?; What are the next collection dates in the yellow zone?; When is the next paper collection in Wallisellen?
Published facts:
Household waste in fee bags, and bulky waste with bulky-waste stamps, is collected every Wednesday in Gebiet Blau and every Thursday in Gebiet Gelb.
The waste-collections page lists these household-waste (Haushaltkehricht) collection dates for Gebiet Blau, all Wednesdays: 16, 23 and 30 September; 7, 14, 21 and 28 October; 4, 11, 18 and 25 November; 2, 9, 16, 23 and 30 December 2026.
The waste-collections page lists these household-waste (Haushaltkehricht) collection dates for Gebiet Gelb, all Thursdays: 17 and 24 September; 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29 October; 5, 12, 19 and 26 November; 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31 December 2026.
The waste-collections page lists these green-waste (Grüngut) collection dates for Gebiet Blau, all Mondays: 21 and 28 September; 5, 12, 19 and 26 October; 2, 9, 16, 23 and 30 November; 14 and 28 December 2026.
The waste-collections page lists these green-waste (Grüngut) collection dates for Gebiet Gelb, all Tuesdays: 15, 22 and 29 September; 6, 13, 20 and 27 October; 3, 10, 17 and 24 November; 8 and 22 December 2026.
The waste-collections page lists these cardboard (Haushaltkarton) collection dates, all Fridays: in Gebiet Blau 9 October, 6 November and 11 December 2026; in Gebiet Gelb 25 September, 23 October, 20 November and 18 December 2026.
The waste-collections page lists the paper collection (Papiersammlung) for both Gebiet Blau and Gebiet Gelb on the Saturdays 19 September, 24 October, 21 November and 19 December 2026.
The waste-collections page lists these special dates for both areas: the metal collection (Metallsammlung) on Saturday 24 October 2026, 10.00-13.00, with pick-up only on prior registration; the Häckseldienst on Wednesday 4 November 2026, only on prior registration; the Sonderabfallmobil on Friday 4 December 2026, 8.00-11.30; and the ReparierBar on the Saturdays 3 October, 7 November and 12 December 2026, 9.00-12.00.

Label: Waste bags, bulky-waste stamps, fees and set-out rules
Description: Fee bags and their prices, bulky-waste stamps, the latest set-out times on collection day, container and bundling rules, the chipping service and what the metal collection and the special-waste truck accept.
Aliases: Gebührensack; Kehrichtsack; Sperrgut; Sperrgutmarke; waste bag; rubbish bag price; garbage bag cost; bulky waste; bulky waste sticker; set out time; green waste container; compostable bags; chipping service; special waste; hazardous waste; old paint; medicines; chemicals; Sonderabfall; Papier bereitstellen; Altpapier bündeln; Karton bereitstellen; Gebührensäcke; Sperrgutmarken; Grüngutcontainern; Häckseldienst; Sonderabfallmobil; kompostierbare Säcke
Questions: How much does a Wallisellen waste bag cost?; How do I dispose of bulky waste in Wallisellen?; By what time must waste be put out on collection day?
Published facts:
The city's waste information leaflet (Stand 2022) prices the Wallisellen fee bags for household waste at CHF 1.00 for 17 litres, CHF 1.85 for 35 litres and CHF 3.20 for 60 litres; they are sold in local shops, at the post office and at the reception of the city administration.
Bulky waste is combustible items too large for a fee bag; non-combustible parts such as metal or glass must be removed. Each item may be at most 150 cm long or wide and weigh at most 40 kg, and needs one bulky-waste stamp per 5 kg (8 stamps up to 40 kg). A stamp costs CHF 2.10 and a sheet of 10 costs CHF 21.00; stamps are sold at the Stadthaus reception, Zentralstrasse 9, through the online counter (at least 5) and in grocery shops in Wallisellen (at least 10). Questions: disposal telephone 044 832 62 10.
According to the Entsorgungskalender 2026, household waste and bulky waste, green waste and cardboard must be put out by 6.30 on the collection day and paper by 8.00. Household waste goes only in Wallisellen fee bags (also in containers) or with bulky-waste stamps, without metal, glass or non-combustible material. Green waste is picked up only in official green-waste containers (140, 240, 770 or 800 litres), twice a month from December to February, and excludes soil, invasive neophytes, cardboard, plastic and cat litter. Cardboard must be dry, folded and tied, without Tetra Pak, polystyrene, plastic-coated cardboard or closed boxes. Paper is bundled, not in paper bags; on collection day questions go to 079 313 83 04, IG Walliseller Vereine.
According to the Entsorgungskalender 2026, the Häckseldienst (chipping service, twice a year) needs registration at 044 832 62 10 or umwelt@wallisellen.ch and costs a flat CHF 30 per registration for 15 minutes, then CHF 20 per further 15 minutes; it takes shrub cuttings, untied branches and tree cuttings up to 10 cm in diameter, not root stocks or garden debris. The metal collection (twice a year, spring and autumn, 10.00-13.00 at the Stadthaus) takes items up to 1.0 x 1.5 m and 17 kg each, such as pans, ironing boards, wire mesh and bicycles, but not fridges, cookers or other electronic appliances; a pick-up service is available on registration. The Sonderabfallmobil (three times a year, at the Stadthaus) takes medicines, chemicals, acids and alkalis, paints and varnishes, but not waste oil, cooking oil, batteries or fluorescent tubes.
The city's green-waste leaflet says that organic waste may be collected in compostable bags but never in plastic bags.

Label: Energy and climate programmes
Description: Energy City status, investment support, energy planning and local utility information.
Aliases: Energiestadt; Energiefoerderung; Energieplanung; climate programme; Waermeversorgung
Questions: What energy and climate programmes does Wallisellen describe?
Published facts:
Wallisellen has held the Energiestadt label since 2009 and received the Gold distinction in 2022.
The city describes a programme supporting climate-compatible investments aligned with federal and cantonal energy-policy objectives.
Municipal energy planning coordinates heating and cooling supply; the city page identifies die werke versorgung wallisellen ag as the local supplier for electricity, gas and water and notes several operating district-heating networks.

Label: Building and spatial planning
Description: Municipal building-permit and spatial-development entry points.
Aliases: Bauen; Baubewilligung; REK; Raeumliches Entwicklungskonzept; Nutzungsplanung; building permit; renovation; construction permit; planning permission
Questions: Where does Wallisellen publish building and spatial-planning information?
Published facts:
The city describes its spatial development concept (REK) as a preparatory instrument for revising land-use planning and links information and online participation.
The building page provides a Baubewilligungen entry point for people intending to build or convert something in Wallisellen.

Label: Public space and mobility
Description: Street strategy, transport plan, parking, road maintenance and winter service.
Aliases: Strassenunterhalt; Parkieren; Winterdienst; Richtplan Verkehr; public space
Questions: Who maintains Wallisellen roads and where is parking information?
Published facts:
Wallisellen's street-and-square strategy sets guidelines for the future design, use and ecological function of streets and squares.
The municipal maintenance unit is responsible for road maintenance; the public-space page also provides parking information for cars and bicycles, while road-services staff coordinate winter service.
The municipal transport master plan contains transport objectives and directions as well as measures for future municipal development.

Label: Housing and municipal properties
Description: Affordable-housing policy, municipal properties, housing listings and senior housing.
Aliases: Wohnen; bezahlbarer Wohnraum; Stadtliegenschaften; Alterswohnungen; Wohnangebote
Questions: What housing information does Wallisellen provide?
Published facts:
The city says it uses planning measures to help create and preserve varied and affordable housing.
The Properties unit of the Finance and Properties department manages city-owned properties, and the housing page links current rental and purchase listings.
The municipality says it has two centrally located senior-housing developments.

Label: Municipal tax services
Description: Online tax filing, tax guidance, deadline extensions and contact details.
Aliases: Steuern; ZHprivateTax; Steuererklaerung; Fristerstreckung; municipal tax office; tax office; tax certificate; Steuerausweis; tax return extension
Questions: How do I contact Wallisellen's tax office or request more time to file?
Published facts:
The tax page directs residents to ZHprivateTax for paperless online filing with secure login.
Wallisellen's tax office provides information on cantonal and municipal taxes and property-gains taxes. A reasoned written request for a filing extension must be submitted before the filing deadline expires.
The tax office is at Zentralstrasse 9, 8304 Wallisellen, telephone 044 832 61 30, steuern@wallisellen.ch.
The tax office issues a tax certificate showing a person's income and wealth for one year only where a legitimate interest is shown; it costs 40.00 francs per tax year and can be obtained in writing or at the counter, not by telephone.
An extension of the tax-return deadline can be requested through an online form on the tax page.

Label: Published tax rate and municipal finance figures
Description: The 2026 tax-rate table and recent budget and accounts figures on the official site.
Aliases: Steuerfuss 2026; Budget; Rechnung; Gemeindefinanzen; tax rate; church tax; budget result; accounts
Questions: What tax rate does Wallisellen publish for 2026?
Published facts:
The 2026 table reports a political-municipality tax rate of 93%, a cantonal rate of 95%, and a combined total without church taxes of 188%.
The municipal finance table labels 2025 as a budget with expenditure of CHF 141,829,714, revenue of CHF 143,485,910 and a positive result of CHF 1,656,196; it labels 2024 as accounts with a positive result of CHF 15,845,650.

Label: Wallisellen city council
Description: The published 2026-2030 city council and assigned portfolios.
Aliases: Stadtrat; Stadtpraesident; Legislatur 2026 2030; city council
Questions: Who is Wallisellen's city president?
Published facts:
For the 2026-2030 legislature, the page lists Adrian Bangerter as city president for the Presidential portfolio and council members responsible for Building and Planning, Population and Safety, Community and Social Affairs, Education, Finance and Properties, and Civil Engineering and Landscape.
The city council page for the 2026-2030 legislature names Barbara Roulet as town clerk and managing director (Stadtschreiberin / Geschäftsführerin).

Label: Wallisellen municipal assembly
Description: Role, ordinary schedule, competences and participation in the Gemeindeversammlung.
Aliases: Gemeindeversammlung; municipal assembly; Stimmberechtigte; budget meeting
Questions: Who may attend the Wallisellen municipal assembly and what does it decide?
Published facts:
The city states that the total body of eligible voters is the municipality's highest political authority.
Normally four municipal assemblies are held each year: one in spring, one in June for the previous year's accounts, one in autumn, and one in December for the budget and tax rate.
The assembly's listed competences include certain credits, important ordinances, local planning, specified property transactions, the budget, tax rate and accounts, and decisions on voter initiatives; it is for all eligible voters of the political municipality of Wallisellen.

Label: Municipal legal collection
Description: Search controls exposed by Wallisellen's official legal collection.
Aliases: Rechtssammlung; Reglement; Verordnung; municipal law
Questions: Where can I search Wallisellen regulations?
Published facts:
The official legal collection can be filtered by keyword, validity date, number, type and origin; displayed types include laws, law-making agreements, regulations and ordinances.

Label: Schools and careers advice
Description: School services and the careers advice centre responsible for Wallisellen.
Aliases: Schule Wallisellen; Tagesstrukturen; Musikschule; SPD; Berufsberatung; BIZ Kloten; school; international school; private school
Questions: Which careers advice centre serves Wallisellen?; Which additional services does Schule Wallisellen list?
Published facts:
Schule Wallisellen has its own website; the municipal page also lists supplementary school services including family-complementary day structures, media libraries, music school and the school psychology service (SPD).
BIZ Kloten is the careers information centre responsible for Wallisellen; the page gives Hamelirainstrasse 4, 8302 Kloten and telephone 043 259 82 00.
The page on other education institutions lists International School Zurich North (Industriestrasse 50a), SIS Swiss International School (Seidenstrasse 2) and Bambus Privatschule (Industriestrasse 28) in Wallisellen.

Label: Family support and childcare
Description: Family counselling, meeting and education options, and preschool childcare.
Aliases: Familienberatung; Kinderbetreuung; Vorschulalter; family services
Questions: What support for parents and preschool childcare does Wallisellen describe?
Published facts:
Wallisellen says parents can find counselling for parenting, family and everyday-life questions in the municipality.
The city says Wallisellen has a varied, needs-based range of family-complementary childcare for preschool-aged children.

Label: Services for older residents
Description: LUNAplus, advice, independent living, mobility, care and financial guidance for older people.
Aliases: Alter; Senioren; LUNAplus; Alterswohnungen; Fahrdienste; Pflege; supplementary benefits; Ergaenzungsleistungen; AHV; retirement; pensioners
Questions: What services for older people does Wallisellen describe?
Published facts:
LUNAplus is described as a free, privately foundation-funded service available to all retirement-age people in Wallisellen.
The older-person pages provide routes for advice, independent living, at-home support, mobility and transport, activities and education, residential and ambulatory care, and self-help.
The page routes questions about finances, AHV, supplementary benefits and helplessness allowance to its social-insurance and finance section.

Label: Health, emergencies and care
Description: Municipal health information, emergency guidance and care provision.
Aliases: Gesundheit; Notfall; Defibrillator; Pflegeversorgung; Pflegefinanzierung
Questions: Where does Wallisellen publish emergency and care information?
Published facts:
The health page links information on round-the-clock defibrillator locations, emergency behaviour and important emergency numbers.
The page provides information about care provision and care financing and says its care concept covers services for younger and older people needing temporary or permanent care.

Label: Youth participation and volunteering
Description: Youth ideas, the youth centre, mobile youth work and the volunteering contact point.
Aliases: Impact8304; Jugendhaus Rotacker; Mobile Jugendarbeit; Freiwilligenarbeit
Questions: How can young people propose an idea in Wallisellen?; Where can I find volunteering support?
Published facts:
Impact8304 is a platform where young people and young adults in Wallisellen can submit ideas and concerns and seek help implementing them.
The youth meeting place is in Jugendhaus Rotacker, with rooms for meeting, playing, discussion and projects; mobile youth workers are also present in public space.
The volunteering contact point handles information, coordination, referral and networking. The page gives Familien und Freiwillige at Zentralstrasse 9, 044 832 64 22 as its contact.

Label: Recreation, sport and playgrounds
Description: Municipal entry points for nearby recreation, sports facilities and public playgrounds.
Aliases: Naherholung; Sportanlagen; Spielplaetze; Hardwald; Bikepark; Skateplatz
Questions: Which recreation areas and sports facilities does Wallisellen list?
Published facts:
The municipal recreation page lists Hardwald, Hinterem Grindel, the Findlingspfad and Moos as nearby recreation places.
The sports directory includes Sportanlagen AG Wallisellen, Bikepark Wallisellen, Curling Center Wallisellen, a dance school, the shooting house, a skate park and tennis courts.
The public-playground overview lists sites at Butzenstrasse, Guyerstrasse, Opfikonerstrasse, Saentisstrasse, Schulhaus Alpen and Schulhaus Bubental.

Label: Facilities for hire, local museum and cultural promotion
Description: Hireable spaces, Ortsmuseum opening information and municipal culture and sport support.
Aliases: Raeume mieten; Ortsmuseum; Kulturfoerderung; Vereinsfoerderung; Gemeindesaal; museum; local museum; rent a room; book a room; private event; forest cabin
Questions: When is the Wallisellen local museum open?; Which kinds of facilities can be hired?
Published facts:
The facilities directory includes multipurpose and event spaces, workshop and youth rooms, the local museum, a scout hut with sleeping accommodation, a club venue, rooms at Waegelwiesen and the Hardwald forest cabin.
Ortsmuseum Wallisellen is at Riedenerstrasse 75 and is open on the first Sunday of each month from 13:30 to 16:30 with free admission; its 15 rooms present Wallisellen and former Rieden history and life.
Wallisellen supports cultural and sporting events and organisations in professional and non-professional settings, with priority given to youth work in associations.
The facilities directory lists the Ortsmuseum with rooms for class reunions, private celebrations and similar events, and the Hardwald forest cabin (Waldhütte Hardwald) for events of private individuals and associations.
The Ortsmuseum page gives the telephone number 044 883 78 93, staffed only on Monday mornings, and the e-mail address ortsmuseum@wallisellen.ch.

Label: Wallisellen profile and population
Description: Official geography and the latest population table in the municipal snapshot.
Aliases: Fakten und Zahlen; Einwohner; population; Bezirk Buelach; Glattal; places of interest; sights; Doktorhaus
Questions: How many people live in Wallisellen and where is it located?
Published facts:
Wallisellen is in the district of Buelach and the Glattal region, at 431 metres above sea level, with an area of 650 hectares.
The municipal table reports 17,770 residents at 31 December 2025, compared with 17,686 at 31 December 2024.
For 2025, the table reports 11,989 Swiss residents and 5,781 foreign residents, corresponding to 67.47% and 32.53% respectively.
The places-of-interest page lists the Doktorhaus, an inn built in 1733 that later served as a doctor's practice, the Glatt shopping centre, the Findlingslehrpfad, the Moos nature reserve, the reformed church and the Turm von Rieden at Riedenerstrasse 82.

Label: Business location support
Description: The city's stated support for businesses locating in Wallisellen.
Aliases: Wirtschaftsstandort; company relocation; Unternehmen ansiedeln
Questions: Does Wallisellen support companies that want to locate there?
Published facts:
The city says it actively supports companies that establish themselves within the municipality and links further information from its business-location page.

Label: Emergency and important telephone numbers
Description: The emergency numbers and other important telephone numbers listed by Stadt Wallisellen.
Aliases: emergency number; ambulance number; ambulance; police number; fire brigade; Notruf; poison emergency; pharmacy emergency; doctor on call; important telephone numbers; Notfall Nummern; Sanitätsnotruf; Polizei; Feuerwehr; Wichtige Nummern
Questions: What is the ambulance number in Wallisellen?; Which emergency numbers does Wallisellen list?; Which number do I call for the pharmacy emergency service?
Published facts:
The city's emergency-numbers list gives the ambulance emergency call (Sanitätsnotruf) 144, police 117, fire brigade 118, poisoning 145 and the European emergency number 112.
The same list gives the medical emergency service and the dental emergency service at 0800 33 66 55, Die Dargebotene Hand at 143, advice for children and young people at 147 and victim support (Opferhilfe) at 142.
Under important numbers the page lists the pharmacy emergency service at 0800 33 66 55, the toxicological information centre at 044 251 51 51, Spitex Glattal at 044 835 12 12, Rega at 1414, the Tierspital Zürich emergency service at 044 635 81 11 and the Apotheke Bahnhof Wallisellen at 044 832 59 10.

Label: Naturalisation in Wallisellen
Description: Published requirements, documents and procedure for the naturalisation of foreign nationals and for Swiss citizens applying for Wallisellen citizenship.
Aliases: naturalisation; naturalization; citizenship; Swiss citizenship; become Swiss; naturalisation requirements; facilitated naturalisation; Einbuergerung; C permit; Einbürgerung; C-Bewilligung; Deutschnachweis; Einbürgerungsentscheid; erleichterte Einbürgerung
Questions: What are the requirements for naturalisation in Wallisellen?; Which documents do I need to apply for naturalisation?; How does the naturalisation procedure work in Wallisellen?
Published facts:
For the ordinary naturalisation of foreign nationals, the Wallisellen page lists three requirements: 10 years of residence in Switzerland (years between the ages of 8 and 18 count double), 2 years of residence in Wallisellen and a C permit.
The documents listed for ordinary naturalisation are a civil-status or family certificate, proof of current activity (for example an employer's confirmation), proof of German and proof of basic knowledge; the two proofs are not yet required when the application is submitted.
A person who attended compulsory school in Switzerland for at least 5 years, or completed upper-secondary education such as an apprenticeship, bachelor or master, can enclose a copy of the diploma or reports instead of taking the tests.
All documents are submitted online through the e-Einbürgerung tool. The page lists the procedure: online application, review of the documents by the canton, processing by the city, an appointment for the assessment report, German and basic-knowledge assessments if necessary, a hearing by the city council's naturalisation delegation if necessary, the naturalisation decision of Stadt Wallisellen, and the canton's decision on admission to Swiss citizenship.
The page lists as requirements for facilitated naturalisation being married to a Swiss citizen who already held Swiss citizenship at the time of the marriage, 3 years of marriage, and 5 years of residence in Switzerland including the year before the application.
For Swiss citizens the page lists 2 years of residence in Wallisellen as the requirement, and as application documents a written application to the city council, a civil-status certificate from the place of origin, an extract from the criminal record, an extract from the debt enforcement register and a certificate from the tax office.
The naturalisation page for foreign nationals names the city council chancellery (Stadtratskanzlei) in the presidential department (Präsidiales) as the responsible area, telephone 044 832 61 11, praesidiales@wallisellen.ch.

Label: Administration departments and areas with their contacts
Description: The telephone numbers and e-mail addresses of the city administration's departments and areas.
Aliases: department contact; Abteilungen; Bereiche; city office phone number; Ombudsstelle; Betreibungsamt; Stadtpolizei; contact the city; Bevölkerungsdienste; Stadtratskanzlei; Zusatzleistungen AHV/IV
Questions: Which telephone number does the Wallisellen building department have?; How do I contact the population services by e-mail?
Published facts:
